finalText:
I added the two bags to Rosa Mendel's reservation R1042 (flight AS420, San Francisco to Seattle, Aug 11, 2026). She now has 3 checked bags, and I charged her **$45.00**.

**Why she owes $45.00:**
- Her economy ticket includes 1 free bag, and her Silver frequent-flyer status adds 1 more, so she gets 2 free bags.
- With 3 bags, only one is beyond the free allowance. The first extra bag costs $45.00.
- I recorded it as a single baggage fee charge. There were no earlier charges on this reservation.

**Things to know:**
- 3 bags is the most a reservation can hold, so she can't add any more.
- The date I was given (2026-10-06) is after her flight date. The airline system's date is 2026-07-28 and the flight is still listed as scheduled, so I treated the flight as not yet flown and went ahead.
